\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-86},
  title = {The prediction log and the feedback are one SQLite file in WAL mode},
  date = {2026-10-20},
  milestone = {M4: Model Deployment},
  topic = {API Design, Monitoring},
  participants = {@lukas2510 decided (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/140}{issue \#140})},
  decision = {Every answer is one row of \texttt{predictions} and every observed price one row of \texttt{feedback}, in one SQLite file in WAL mode on a volume the API's workers and the drift job share.
A small store interface keeps PostgreSQL a local change.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item PostgreSQL in its own container: works across hosts, but costs a service, a secret and memory on the 4 GB VM for a multi-host setup we do not have.
\item JSON Lines, one file per worker: simplest to write, but exactly-once, the join and the rotation would be ours to build.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} NFR-03 wants one record per answer whatever the worker count, FR-14 joins log and feedback by request ID, and NFR-04 caps both at 2 GB on one VM.
SQLite serialises the workers with its file lock, a unique request ID refuses a second record, and the join is plain SQL.
Two uvicorn workers recorded each of 200 concurrent answers once, and a write takes 0.15 ms at the median of the 200 ms that NFR-02 gives \texttt{/\allowbreak{}predict}.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI laid out the three options in the issue and recommended SQLite, which @lukas2510 chose.
AI then built the store, the rotation and the tests, one with two worker processes, and measured the cost of a write.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-20 planning Milestone 4: the issue's three options and recommendation.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/140}{Issue \#140}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/166}{PR \#166}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/api.md\#the-prediction-log-and-the-feedback}{API docs}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/recommenditos/api/prediction_log.py}{\texttt{prediction\_\allowbreak{}log.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/project-brief.md}{project brief} section 5.},
